import process;

[Target(OS(Windows))]
hang(): process.Command {
    return process.Command("ping").arguments(["-n", "1000", "127.0.0.1"]);
}

[Target(!OS(Windows))]
hang(): process.Command {
    return process.Command("sleep").argument("1000");
}

# Recurses `n` deep; the print after the call keeps an optimizer from
# making it a loop.
depth(n: int): int {
    if (n == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    var below = depth(n - 1);
    if (below < 0) {
        print("unreachable");
    }
    return below + 1;
}

[Test]
starts_a_child_and_overflows_its_stack() {
    hang().spawn();
    expect_equal(depth(100000000), 0);
}
